Status values: **Open** means no fix is released. **Fixed** means a released version corrects the problem. **Closed, no fix** means the behavior will not change; the entry explains why.

## KI-001: Installer is not digitally signed {#ki-001}

**Affects:** 0.5.9

**Status:** Open

**Results impact:** None. This issue does not affect computed results.

**Symptom:** Windows SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC" when you start the installer. Some organizations block unsigned programs.

**Workaround:** Compare the installer's SHA-256 hash with the value on the [Releases](releases/index.qmd#download) page. If the hashes match, select **More info**, then **Run anyway**. If your organization blocks the installer, ask your IT department for help.

**Fix:** Code signing is planned. Until then, Windows may show a SmartScreen warning when you start the installer.

## Report a new issue

Open an issue in the [moves-utilities repository]({{< var contact.url >}}). You need a GitHub account.

Include the application version from **Settings**, then **About**, the MOVES version, and the steps that cause the problem. Do not send passwords or database connection details.
